topic: an overlooked invention that changed daily life
title: The Overlooked Invention You Use Everyday

media.title: File:National Museum of Nature and Science P5189092.jpg
File:National Museum of Nature and Science P5189092.jpg

script: You use this overlooked invention dozens of times a day without even noticing. It was patented in 1893 by Whitcomb Judson, who just wanted an easier way to fasten his high-topped shoes. Originally called the clasp locker, it was bulky and jammed constantly. Years later, engineer Gideon Sundback redesigned it into the modern interlocking teeth we know today. Renamed by B.F. Goodrich for how fast it closed boots, the zipper quietly revolutionized fashion, luggage, and gear forever. Next time you zip up your jacket, remember this tiny marvel shaped modern convenience.
